items.author: vltansky
items.body:
Hi! Small compatibility suggestion for Codex users.

OpenAI Codex skills support optional `agents/openai.yaml` metadata for invocation policy: https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills#optional-metadata

For skills that are intended to be explicitly invoked rather than auto-matched, it would be useful to add:

```yaml
policy:
  allow_implicit_invocation: false
```

The docs describe this as keeping explicit `$skill` invocation working while preventing Codex from implicitly invoking the skill based on the user prompt.

items.author: emretfn
items.body:
## Summary
The `handoff` skill instructs the agent to create the handoff document at a path produced by:

```bash
mktemp -t handoff-XXXXXX.md
```

This relies on GNU `mktemp` behavior, where `-t` treats the argument as a template and replaces the trailing `X` characters with random ones. On macOS, the default BSD `mktemp` interprets `-t` differently — the argument is used as a literal **prefix** and a random suffix is appended at the end.

## Actual behavior (macOS / BSD mktemp)
Running the exact command from the skill:

```bash
mktemp -t handoff-XXXXXX.md
```

produces:

```
/var/folders/hj/.
items.title: `handoff` skill's `mktemp -t handoff-XXXXXX.md` doesn't produce the intended filename on macOS (BSD mktemp)
